sections.title: Gru's Phase Gates: Validated, Not Attempted
sections.key_case: a one-pass checkout design whose vague need ('improve user experience') lets a 'might as well add' recommendation widget trace and ship; gate 2 makes the need falsifiable and gate 4 turns the widget back
